specification.family_title: Connection recovery and unsafe pool reuse
specification.title: The backend of a failing transaction is terminated before its ROLLBACK; then the next unit of work runs on the same pool
steps: Unit 1: start a transaction with the framework's ordinary transaction API, on a pool of one connection.
Checkpoint `unit1-after-write`: report pg_current_xact_id() and pg_backend_pid(). The runner terminates that backend and waits until it has gone. Then wait settle_ms.
Raise an application error inside the transaction. The framework attempts ROLLBACK on the closed connection, which fails.
Checkpoint `after-unit1`: report the same backend PID; the runner records that session's state.

Unit 2, the next unit of work on the same pool: start a transaction, write the marker `next`, checkpoint `unit2-after-write` (report pg_current_xact_id() and pg_backend_pid()), and end normally. Give up after settings.bound_ms and report the unit as pending.
Checkpoint `after-end`, as soon as the API has returned: the runner records the state at report time.

invariants.statement: Unrelated work never runs inside, or commits, a transaction whose rollback failed: that transaction is never committed, and the next unit of work runs in a transaction of its own.
After the failure, the next unit of work on the same pool completes within the bound (settings.bound_ms) and commits.

execution.description: TypeORM's defaults, with the managed transaction API ds.transaction(callback).

server.version: PostgreSQL 18.6 (Debian 18.6-1.pgdg13+2) on aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu, compiled by gcc (Debian 14.2.0-19) 14.2.0, 64-bit

fault.mechanism: pg_terminate_backend(pid), run by the runner from its own connection.
fault.injection_point: Inside unit 1, after its write, before the framework's ROLLBACK.
fault.preconditions: The PID the adapter reports belongs to the case's database.
fault.expected_server: The backend exits, and unit 1's transaction is rolled back.
fault.expected_client: An error from the framework's rollback; the pool holds a closed connection.

knowledge: The framework knows that its connection failed.

api_outcome.basis: ds.transaction(callback) rejected with the error the callback threw
api_outcome.contract: In TypeORM 1.1.2, ds.transaction(callback) (EntityManager.transaction) starts a transaction, runs the callback, calls commitTransaction() and returns the callback's result; if the callback throws, it calls rollbackTransaction(), ignores any rollback error, and rethrows (entity-manager/EntityManager.js). A resolved call is TypeORM's report that the transaction committed.

unit2.contract: In TypeORM 1.1.2, ds.transaction(callback) (EntityManager.transaction) starts a transaction, runs the callback, calls commitTransaction() and returns the callback's result; if the callback throws, it calls rollbackTransaction(), ignores any rollback error, and rethrows (entity-manager/EntityManager.js). A resolved call is TypeORM's report that the transaction committed.

the runner terminated the backend at `unit1-after-write`, and it had gone before the adapter resumed
the next unit of work was attempted
